Name: CC Athletics
Description:
Revolutionizing Athletic Performance Testing. 

At CC Athletics, we believe cutting-edge sports technology should be accessible, straightforward, and truly yours. Based in Denmark, we design and manufacture high-precision force plates and isometric testing equipment that empower coaches, physiotherapists, and sports organizations to make data-driven decisions without recurring subscription fees.

Our Mission: Technology That Belongs to You
In an industry dominated by subscription models and hidden costs, we've taken a different path. When you invest in professional equipment, you should own it completely – including the software, updates, and your data. Forever. This philosophy drives everything we do.

Premium Danish Assembly
Every CC Athletics product is assembled in our Danish facility with uncompromising quality standards. While we source premium components from trusted suppliers, each unit is carefully assembled by hand in Denmark with comprehensive quality checks throughout the process. Our software is developed entirely in-house, ensuring seamless integration and continuous improvement based on user feedback.

Our Products

PlateMate Force Plates – Golden-standard precision meets practical usability. 960 Hz sampling rate, 4,000 kg maximum load, and externally validated precision. Test jumps, movements, balance, and isometrics with 100+ metrics.

GroinMate – Measure adduction and abduction strength with 960 Hz accuracy and 200 kg maximum load. Designed for real-world clinical and training environments.

CableMate – Portable force measurement with 8-hour battery life and 200 kg maximum load. Measure force output across multiple muscle groups anywhere.

Software Without Compromise
Lifetime access to all features and updates – no monthly fees, no surprises. Access 100+ scientifically validated metrics through an intuitive, user-friendly interface. Your data lives in the cloud and remains yours to access, analyze, and export.

Name: Buchardt Audio
Description:
What makes us different? 
Buchardt Audio is a Danish based high-end loudspeaker manufacturer. Our goal is to provide state-of-the-art sound at an affordable price. We have succeeded in this task with the help of some of the most talented developers and engineers in the industry. Our speakers are the product of a long and meticulous design process.

Don't let the cost of our speakers dissuade you. They can compete with products well above their price range.

Reaching these prices without compromise is impossible. If compromises on the product and development processes are not an option, we need to look elsewhere. We have eliminated expensive marketing, distributors, agents and Hi-Fi dealers. By selling directly to the end user, we eliminate about 60-70% of the cost in comparison to our competitors. Direct sales is not anything new. More and more small companies are doing this. What makes us different is that we rely on big scale production where we produce thousands of speakers in batches, so we benefit from the best possible prices on the parts we use.    

Our focus is purely on consistent performance and quality. To achieve this, we outsource production to a company that knows what it’s doing, and can handle the large scale production we need. The company is the respected Danish/Chinese-owned Company: Hansong in Nanjing, China. Hansong has extensive experience in manufacturing for some of the most well known High-End Hi-Fi brands in the world! 

To us, it is of vital importance that the production facility we use offers the best working conditions for the employees. Hansong offers special healthcare benefits to all employees along with apartments and free electric bus rides to the city. Hansong is ISO 9001 certified and has facilities in China, Denmark and USA.

Our products are finally shipped to our warehouse in Denmark where we do an final quality control before shipping to our customers.

Name: Somfy Danmark
Description:
Somfy Danmark er en del af Somfy-koncernen. I Danmark beskæftiger vi os med alt fra projekter i millionklassen til salg til private hjem. Vi tilbyder en bred vifte af intelligente styringer og stille motorer, som optimerer den visuelle og termiske komfort, energiforbrug og udnyttelse af naturligt lys i arbejds- og opholdsmiljø. Somfy Projects gruppen arbejder består af et kompetent og erfarent team med dybtgående viden om solskærmindustrien. Somfy Pro teamet har ligeledes gennem mange år arbejdet dedikeret med en bred vifte af intelligente styringer og motorer til professionelle forhandlere i hele Danmark og de seneste år ligeledes arbejdet dedikeret med Somfy Smart Home løsninger og uddannelse af forhandlernettet i Danmark. Siden 2017 har Somfy Danmark optimeret sin digitale tilstedeværelse og supporterer i dag markedet med Smart Home løsninger til private. 
Vores projektteam har evnen til at hjælpe dig fra start til færdiggørelse med ekspertisen til at designe, levere, levere og understøtte alle aspekter af dynamisk solskærmning ... dybest set er vi her for at hjælpe! Vi har også evnen til at tilbyde attraktive vedligeholdelsesaftaler, efter at installationen er gennemført. Typiske støtteaktiviteter, vi leverer spænder fra rådgivning (tegninger, elektriske tidsplaner, planlægning) i de tidlige faser, over til installationen og endelig systemvedligeholdelse.
Uanset hvilken form eller form, kan Somfy tilbyde den optimale dynamiske solafskærmningsløsning til din bygning takket være innovative produkter (motorer, facade styringssystemer og lokale styringer). Find en Somfy-løsning til ethvert projekt - kompatibelt med alle solafskærmings og åbningsenheder. Vi har meget stærke tilbud til vores nøglesegmenter: kontorer, uddannelse, sundhedspleje, lodret bolig og gæstfrihed. Kontakt dit lokale Somfy Projects kontor for yderligere information om vores proprietære løsninger (Solo, IB +, IP) og åbne standard (KNX eller LON).
